Title: Open BIOS
Subtitle: Choose a source to inspect the firmware.
AnalysisSubtitle: Image information, concise Secure Boot warnings, UEFI driver security status, firmware structure, and Intel flash regions.
Support: Official support: LGA2011-3 / X99 boards, Windows 11. Other boards may work; compatibility is not guaranteed.

TpmSubtitle: TPM support found in the opened image and the boot report collected by the optional passive UEFI diagnostic driver. No Windows TPM, WMI, registry, or external database data is used for firmware analysis.
SaveSubtitle: Save the current verified image to a file or flash only its BIOS region through the bundled ThrottleStop driver.
TpmNoImageEvidence: No recognized TPM/TCG markers were found in the opened image. This does not prove that the physical TPM is absent.
TpmDebugDriverPassiveMessage: The DXE driver waits for ReadyToBoot and then performs read-only diagnostics: TCG/TCG2, TPM ACPI/AML policy, CPU topology, EFI PCI root bridges (up to 8 detailed entries), Wellsburg LPC/RCBA, and TPM TIS/PTP localities 0–4 with EFI_STATUS for each MMIO read. The CRC-protected report is stored in a UEFI variable. The driver sends no TPM commands and does not modify decode, strap, RCBA, or protection registers.
TpmNoBootReportMessage: Install the debug driver into the image, flash that image, reboot, then reopen this page. The report is read from the driver’s UEFI variable.
TpmBootReportReadErrorTitle: Boot report could not be read
TpmDebugMutationBlocked: The TPM debug driver cannot be safely added or removed from this image. The firmware layout is incomplete, ambiguous, duplicated, or has no verified in-place space.
TpmDebugDriverUnsafeVersion: This image contains an older or unrecognized XeonV3 TPM Debug driver. Direct flashing is blocked. On the TPM page, remove the debug driver and install it again so the image contains the current X99-safe version.
TpmDebugSourceChanged: The BIOS image changed after TPM debug-driver preflight.

BIOS_CNTL.BIOSWE may be enabled temporarily for the write and is restored afterwards. Power loss during erase/program can still brick the board.

TpmAcpiMethodNotEvaluated: AML method (not executed by the diagnostic driver)
